(Currently Amended) A method of treating Argininosuccinate Synthetase Deficiency (ASD), comprising administering to a subject in need of treatment a composition comprising __an mRNA encoding argininosuccinate synthetase (ASS1) encapsulated within a liposome__ at an effective dose and an administration interval such that at least one symptom or feature of __the ASD__ is reduced in intensity, severity, or frequency __or has a delayed onset__.

(Currently Amended) The method of claim 14, wherein the administering of the composition results in increased serum ASS1 protein level __in the subject as compared to the baseline serum ASS1 protein level before the treatment__.

(Currently Amended) The method of claim 15, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced citrulline level in the subject as compared to __the baseline citrulline level in the subject__ before the treatment.

(Currently Amended) The method of claim 16, wherein the administering of the composition results in reduced ammonia level in the subject as compared to __the baseline ammonia level in the subject__ before the treatment.

(Currently Amended) The method of claim 20, wherein the mRNA is __modified to enhance stabilization and/or translation efficiency__.
